profiles.description: Big Sky Industrial Inc., an independent energy company, focuses on the acquisition, exploration, and development of industrial gas, and oil and natural gas properties in the continental United States. The company's principal properties and operations are located in the Rockies region, including Montana and Wyoming; the Mid-Continent region comprising Oklahoma, and North and East Texas; West Texas; South Texas; and the Gulf Coast regions. The company was formerly known as U.S. Energy Corp. and changed its name to Big Sky Industrial Inc. in June 2026. Big Sky Industrial Inc. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
